images.title: 89 in base 5
images.purpose: Shows 89 written in the base 5 system as 3 hexagons, 2 squares and 4 triangles.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Three groups of shapes in a row, each with a short product under it, and the total at the right.
images.exact_structure: Left group: exactly 3 hexagons (amber #E69F00). Middle group: exactly 2 squares (teal #0072B2). Right group: exactly 4 small triangles (reddish purple #CC79A7). All shapes have dark outlines; clear space between groups. Under the groups, in dark text: 3 × 25, 2 × 5, 4 × 1. At the far right, a dark equals sign and then the number 89 in large dark text. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: In base 5 the landmarks are 1, 5, 25, 125: 89 is three 25s, two 5s and four 1s.
images.description: Shows 89 written in the base 5 system as 3 hexagons, 2 squares and 4 triangles.

image_decisions.why: The shapes make the grouping into powers of 5 countable at a glance.
